subject: Terrafirma renewal QBR — split demo proposal & runbook
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
To: Laura Gomez <laura.gomez@terrafirma.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Terrafirma renewal QBR — split demo proposal & runbook

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for committing time for the upcoming renewal QBR. Based on our pre-call notes and the stakeholder list you shared, it sounds like the meeting will need to cover: 1) a high-level executive recap (contract/ROI + adoption highlights), and 2) a short technical roadmap + live demo focused on the performance/latency improvements from our Dedicated offering.

To reduce the chance of a long meeting and to make the session useful for both execs and engineers, we propose splitting the QBR into two contiguous blocks on the same day: a 30-minute executive sync followed immediately by a 45-minute technical walkthrough + live demo. Proposed windows (your timezone):
- Option A: 2027-09-29, 10:00–11:15 PT (exec 10:00–10:30, tech 10:30–11:15)
- Option B: 2027-09-29, 14:00–15:15 PT (exec 14:00–14:30, tech 14:30–15:15)

Operational asks from our side:
- We’ll record both blocks and provide a short excerpt for execs.
- Monica will own the tech demo runbook; Markus will join the exec portion.
- Please confirm the final attendee list (we'll need names/emails for calendar invites and breakout ownership).

Attached is a two-page agenda and a runbook checklist for the split-demo. If neither window works, share two windows you prefer and we’ll align.

Best,
Rishi
Head of Renewals | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: Terrafirma_QBR_Agenda_v2.pdf, Runbook_SplitDemo_checklist.xlsx
From: Laura Gomez <laura.gomez@terrafirma.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: James Li <james.li@terrafirma.com>, Procurement <procurement@terrafirma.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Terrafirma renewal QBR — split demo proposal & runbook

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the clear options and the runbook. Quick update: our CTO has a standing leadership review from 10:15–11:00 on the 29th and can’t make Option A exec slot. Option B looks closer but we have two engineers in APAC who would need an earlier option.

Could we do a stitch like this instead?
- Executive sync (30m): 2027-09-29, 09:00–09:30 PT — leadership only (CTO & head of procurement)
- Technical deep-dive (45m): 2027-09-29, 13:00–13:45 PT — engineers and SREs (we’ll send the invite to a larger technical audience)

If we have to split across the day, we’d prefer both to happen on the 29th (keeps procurement work consolidated). Also: our security team will want to review the SOC2 snapshot and the dedicated deployment options you plan to demo; can you have a one-pager or quick artifacts ready? James from procurement is looped for timing and PO readiness.

Laura
Director of IT Operations
Terrafirma
laura.gomez@terrafirma.com

Subject: FW: Terrafirma renewal QBR — split demo proposal & runbook

Team — quick internal plan based on Laura’s reply (see thread below):

1) Split schedule confirmed preference: exec at 09:00–09:30 PT + tech at 13:00–13:45 PT on 2027-09-29. Laura asked for both on the same day to keep procurement momentum.

2) Ownership:
- Exec portion (09:00–09:30): Markus to lead executive recap (contract summary + ROI snapshot). Rishi will handle Q&A on pricing/commit and procurement asks.
- Tech portion (13:00–13:45): Monica to own demo runbook and live performance test. Priyom to prepare the deployment diagrams and the Dedicated vs Hosted latency comparison.

3) Deliverables before EOD 2027-09-24:
- One-pager for security (SOC2 excerpt + onboarding constraints) for Laura’s team — Priyom
- Finalized slides and 2-min highlight clip for execs — Markus + Rishi
- Tech runbook with failovers and recording instructions — Monica (use the attached checklist)

4) Backup/ops: need two hosts listed as fallbacks in the calendar invite in case of network issues. Monica — can you nominate a backup SRE and confirm the recording link (we’ll use internal recording + provide MP4 afterward)?

I’ll draft the invite once we have the attendee list and the one-pager.

Thanks,
Rishi

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: Laura Gomez <laura.gomez@terrafirma.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Terrafirma renewal QBR — split demo proposal & runbook

Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround and James for looping procurement. Confirming we can run the split day as you requested: exec 09:00–09:30 PT and technical 13:00–13:45 PT on 2027-09-29.

Logistics and what to expect:
- Attendance: please send final attendee names/emails by Friday 2027-09-24 so we can lock calendar invites.
- Security artefacts: Priyom will attach the SOC2 excerpt and a one-page onboarding checklist to the calendar invite.
- Recording plan: We will record the tech portion and create a 3–4 minute highlight clip for execs within 48 hours.
- Failover: Backup host is Priyom Das (priom.das@redwood.inference.com) and our secondary recorder will be internal conference room recorder (MP4 delivered post-call).

Laura — quick ask: for the tech deep-dive, can you confirm whether your SREs want a live load run (we can simulate a 10k tokens/min steady-state) or prefer a pre-recorded latency demo? Live run requires a sustained network path and a test key — we can bring both but want to know your preference.

Thanks — Monica
Customer Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.inference.com
